text.en: These Rules may be cited as the Postal (Surface Letter Rates) (Local and Commonwealth) Rules. “Commonwealth rate” means the rate for postal articles sent from a post office in Brunei Darussalam to a post office within the British Commonwealth to the Republic of Ireland or other than to a territory which the local rate applies; “local rate” means the rate for postal articles sent from one post office in Brunei Darussalam to another post office in Sarawak or Sabah.

The local and Commonwealth rates by surface mail for the postal articles specified in the first column of the Schedule shall be such as appear opposite thereto in the second and third columns of the Schedule respectively. Special conditions relating to newspapers etc.

No newspaper, small packet, book or commercial paper shall contain any letter or manuscript having the character of actual correspondence, and all such articles shall be made up in such a manner as to enable the contents thereof to be easily examined. (rule 3)
